title: Q2
description:
Read: Psa 2:7-8

The decree names the king Son, and the next line gives him the nations. The word rendered "worlds" is ages.

a) The inheritance is named in the same breath as the Son, before any sitting down. What does the psalm's order fix that inheritance to be?

b) Set against the nations in the same decree, what are the ages He is appointed over?
